newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - November 28.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - November 28.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse was 4.7 million zlotys on Thursday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse:
* 3,200 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on October 12, 2001, traded at 81.45 zlotys.
* 10,000 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on November 9, 1997, traded at 101.60 zlotys.
* 10,000 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on November 6, 1999, traded at 100.3 zlotys.
